tools.name: find_answers
tools.description: Start here for an SAP AI & analytics PROBLEM, asked in EN, FR or DE (agents in production, Joule value, BW 7.5 cliff, BDC vs Datasphere vs Databricks…). Returns up to 3 tracked challenges: short answer, what shipped, what is announced, next steps, citation_url. Empty = not a tracked challenge; try s

tools.name: search_firms
tools.description: Search SAP AI & analytics service providers (consultancies, Big-4, agencies, SAP partners, platforms). Returns slug, name, HQ, website, claim, sap_signal_band; SAP end-customers are in find_sap_clients. Public.

tools.name: count_firms_by
tools.description: Count the firm directory by country, region, kind, module or sap_signal_band, with search_firms' filters, instead of paging search_firms to tally. Rows: value, n; the tail folds into '(other)'. Public.

tools.name: get_firm
tools.description: One firm's public profile by its slug from search_firms (verbatim; some slugs are numeric). A brand name such as 'accenture' returns the list of its entities to choose from. Public.

tools.name: list_firm_kinds
tools.description: The organisation kinds of the firm directory with a live count each — the vocabulary of search_firms' `kind`. Public, complete without a key.

tools.name: list_freelance_platforms
tools.description: Platforms where an SAP consultant can create a profile (freelance marketplaces, job boards, expert networks), with signup URL, confidence grade and assessment date. Public, complete without a key.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Search public SAP AI & analytics postings. Mostly PERMANENT roles: set employment_type for freelance questions. A posting listed in several cities is one row with `locations`. Public, except the link to the original listing (paid).

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search the curated SAP AI & analytics news corpus; defaults to SAP-specific items (scope 'sap'). Each item carries source_url (the publisher) and citation_url: cite both. Public.

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Search the SAP AI & analytics concept encyclopaedia (the stack's vocabulary): slug, title, category, level, editor's summary. Full card: get_concept_card (paid). Public.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: One concept's metadata and editor's summary by slug from search_concepts (e.g. 'sap-business-data-cloud-bdc'). The card body, cheat sheet and tables are paid (get_concept_card). Public.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.description: List the deep-research studies: title, edition, as-of date, audience, word count, citation_url, one row per study in the language asked. Metadata only; the text is get_study (paid). Public.

tools.name: get_day_rate_benchmark
tools.description: Published SAP freelance day-rate aggregate by country, specialisation and seniority: min/max (median, p10, p90 when sourced) in the row's currency, with source, date and confidence. Small, secondary sources; 0 rows = no such cell here, see `_meta.available_*`. Public.

tools.name: list_sap_modules
tools.description: The SAP module/product taxonomy (codes such as DATASPHERE, BDC, SAC, BW4HANA with labels) that other tools filter on; use it to map loose wording to a code. Public, complete without a key.

tools.name: find_academy_modules
tools.description: Search the Academy training catalogue (Datasphere, BDC, SAC, BW/4HANA, Databricks) by text, track or level. Rows are in the language asked. Full text: get_academy_module (paid). Public.

tools.name: query_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Relations between concepts, Academy modules, studies and vendors: list nodes (node_type, query) or one node's edges (node_id). The only tool that serves edges. Public.

tools.name: get_concept_card
tools.description: The full concept card: body, cheat sheet, glossary, pro tip and the four analysis tables, EN/FR/DE. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Read a study's text: without `section` returns the section list and introduction, then pass a heading as `section`. Slugs from list_studies. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_academy_module
tools.description: Read one Academy module in full (body, objectives, summary) by id or slug from find_academy_modules; `lang` picks one language. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: find_sap_clients
tools.description: Search the SAP END-CUSTOMER corpus (companies that run SAP); each row says its verification status. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_sap_client_profile
tools.description: One SAP end-customer's full profile (products in use, modules, analytics solutions, evidence) by id from find_sap_clients. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_expansion_brief
tools.description: Brief for entering a region: providers there (local vs group), SAP end-customer counts by country and industry, live opportunities, brand families present in both regions. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: find_partner_candidates
tools.description: Rank local service providers of a country or region as partner or acquisition candidates; local_only (default) excludes foreign groups' subsidiaries. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: get_firm_intel
tools.description: Intelligence profile of a services firm: SAP practice size, partner level, products delivered, typical day rate, notable clients. Search by name, country, product or engagement mode; a null is a data gap. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.description: ACTION: deposit an SAP need as a private brief, matched every 6 h against consenting consultants; nothing is e-mailed. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

tools.name: request_introduction
tools.description: ACTION: a brief's anonymised selection, or with candidate_ref an introduction request the consultant answers in the app. Paid: MCP Pass or Firm Pass key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_freelance_platforms · Private data: submit_brief · Public sink: submit_brief · Destructive: find_sap_clients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_freelance_platforms · Private data: submit_brief · Public sink: submit_brief · Destructive: find_sap_clients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
